entries.desc: Classification report groups all current main dirty paths into baseline artifacts, docs, story metadata, and untracked docs.

evidence.note: Main dirty classification grouped as 3 untracked docs, 119 tracked deletes, and 23 tracked modifications. Paths were separated into baseline artifacts, docs, and untracked docs for reconciliation.

entries.desc: Deleted tracked baseline artifacts are classified separately from modified suite reports and untracked docs.

evidence.note: Tracked deleted baseline artifacts were identified separately: Layer2 has 117 deletes and 4 modifications; Layer3 has 2 deletes and 17 modifications.

entries.desc: No .omx path is read or used while classifying dirty assets.

evidence.note: No .omx path appeared in the dirty status classification.

entries.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI both produce independent audit conclusions for the dirty asset groups.

evidence.command: Claude CLI and Codex CLI read-only audits
evidence.note: Claude docs auditor and Codex docs auditor both found the main formal-unlock document obsolete/conflicting with B-9d6c. Codex baseline auditor found baseline artifacts BLOCKED/not_authorized and recommended restore/defer rather than commit. Claude baseline auditor also returned BLOCK, though its inventory was incomplete; final auditor did not rely on its optimistic commit suggestion.

entries.desc: If the hosts disagree, the cleanup does not proceed until the disagreement is explicitly resolved.

evidence.command: Final auditor reconciliation of four host outputs
evidence.note: Disagreement was handled by fail-closed logic: stale/BLOCKED baseline artifacts were not committed; only Layer4 document plus synchronized NAV was committed; story-lifecycle and B3787 audit plan were deferred in stash.

entries.desc: Host audit does not convert local evidence or host verdicts into Authority Server receipt evidence.

evidence.note: All host audit outputs were treated as local non-authority evidence only. No Authority receipt, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or global capability claim was inferred from Claude or Codex host verdicts.

entries.desc: Main worktree becomes clean after the audited reconciliation and B-9d6c can retry DONE.

evidence.note: Main worktree is clean after committing Layer4 docs plus NAV, deferring stale/non-ready assets into stash, and completing B-9d6c DONE.

entries.desc: If B-9d6c DONE exposes a new explicit blocker, the blocker is reported without further arbitrary cleanup.

evidence.note: B-9d6c advanced to DONE successfully, merged story/B-9d6c back to main, cleaned its worktree, and produced merge commit a55a3f34.

entries.desc: Cleanup does not use .omx, git reset --hard, or unreviewed deletion of useful Lattice evidence.

evidence.command: git stash list and targeted cleanup transcript
evidence.note: No .omx path was used. No git reset --hard was run. Stale baseline artifacts and non-ready docs were preserved in stash@{0}: B-d925 defer stale artifacts and non-ready docs before B-9d6c DONE.
